pet_notes: Rita Rossweisse, classic short-haired black-and-white combat maid costume ONLY. Clean polished 2D anime chibi, about 2.6 heads tall, mature poise. Ash-brown bob and side-swept fringe covering anatomical LEFT eye (front screen-right), visible wine-red RIGHT eye (front screen-left). White frilled maid headband with black bows and a small wine-red rose on anatomical RIGHT temple (front screen-left). White puff shoulder sleeves, fitted black bodice, white waist apron and white frilled short skirt, dark long gloves, dark thigh-high stockings and black low-heel shoes. Keep both hands empty; no scythe, cup, flowers, tool, floor shadow, aura or effects. Follow qa/identity-lock.md. Preserve asymmetry; do NOT mirror left gait. Keep natural visible eye comfortably open for idle; never reveal an invented second eye. Anatomical scale consistent, compact body with clear face and clean outlines.
